meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分镜、节拍和字幕脚本渲染成视频成片,本地或云端都能出片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把脚本和分镜做成可渲染的视频成片,并需要本地或云端批量产出。
copy.tagline_en: Turn storyboards, beats and captions into finished videos, local or cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you turn scripts and storyboards into rendered video, locally or in the cloud

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你搭项目、搜现成动效、写合成、检查、预览并渲染视频，构建或渲染失败时还能帮你排查。产出是本地或云端渲染出的视频文件。
howto.when: 当你要求用 HyperFrames 创建、预览或渲染视频，遇到构建或渲染失败，或提到 init、check、render 等命令时触发。

say.text: 用 npx hyperframes init 建一个新项目
帮我检查这个合成有什么问题
say.note: 运行 check，内部先跑 lint
渲染需先通过并等你确认

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude scaffolds HyperFrames video projects, searches a local catalog for ready-made motion, writes compositions, runs lint and check, previews, and renders locally or in the cloud. It can also diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to create, preview, or render a HyperFrames video, when a build or render fails, or when you mention commands like init, check, or render.

say_en.text: Render it to out.mp4 at high quality
